parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description:
The database account.

> You can specify multiple database accounts. Separate multiple accounts with a space. For example: `user1 user2 user3`.

parameters.name: ChildDBInstanceIDs
parameters.description:
The node ID.

> This parameter is required if the database instance is a PolarDB for MySQL cluster.

parameters.name: DBName
parameters.description:
The database name.

> You can specify multiple database names. Separate multiple names with a space. For example: `DB1 DB2 DB3`.

parameters.name: End
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. This value must be a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

> The end time must be later than the start time. The time range cannot exceed one day.

parameters.name: Fail
parameters.description: The SQL execution error code. You can call the [GetAsyncErrorRequestStatByCode](~~409804~~) operation to obtain the error code.

parameters.name: HostAddress
parameters.description:
The client IP address.

> You can specify multiple client IP addresses. Separate multiple IP addresses with a space. For example: `IP1 IP2 IP3`.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the database instance.

parameters.name: LogicalOperator
parameters.description:
The logical operator to use with multiple keywords. Valid values:

- **or**

- **and**

parameters.name: MaxLatancy
parameters.description: The maximum execution time in microseconds. Returns SQL statements that have an execution time less than this value.

parameters.name: MaxRecordsPerPage
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 5 to 100.

parameters.name: MaxRows
parameters.description: A reserved parameter.

parameters.name: MaxScanRows
parameters.description: The maximum number of scanned rows. Returns SQL statements that scanned fewer than this number of rows.

parameters.name: MaxSpillCnt
parameters.description: A reserved parameter.

parameters.name: MinLatancy
parameters.description: The minimum execution time in microseconds. Returns SQL statements with an execution time greater than or equal to this value.

parameters.name: MinRows
parameters.description: A reserved parameter.

parameters.name: MinScanRows
parameters.description: The minimum number of scanned rows. Returns SQL statements that scanned at least this number of rows.

parameters.name: MinSpillCnt
parameters.description: A reserved parameter.

parameters.name: PageNumbers
parameters.description: The page number to return. Pages start from 1. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: QueryKeyword
parameters.description:
The query keyword.

> Fuzzy search is supported. You can specify up to 10 keywords. Separate multiple keywords with a space. For example: a1 b2 c3.

parameters.name: Role
parameters.description: A reserved parameter.

parameters.name: SortKey
parameters.description:
The sort key. Valid values:

- **ScanRows**: scanned rows.

- **UpdateRows**: updated rows.

- **Consume**: execution time.

- **OriginTime**: The execution start time.

- **ReturnRows**: returned rows.

parameters.name: SortMethod
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **ASC**: ascending

- **DESC**: descending

parameters.name: SqlType
parameters.description: The SQL type.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description:
The start of the time range to query. This value must be a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

> You can query only data that is generated after you enable DAS Enterprise Edition. The start time cannot be earlier than seven days before the current time.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description: The execution state. Set this parameter to **0** to query for successfully executed SQL statements. You can also specify an error code to query for the corresponding SQL statements.

parameters.name: ThreadID
parameters.description:
The thread ID.

> You can specify multiple thread IDs. Separate multiple IDs with a space. For example: `657 658 659`.

parameters.name: TraceId
parameters.description: A reserved parameter.

parameters.name: TransactionId
parameters.description: The transaction ID.
